name: payment.balance
description: Read your own wallet balance in USD cents.

name: payment.transfer
description: Pay a world-directory recipient from your own wallet. Generate a UUID and reuse it for retries; amounts are USD cents.

name: payment.banks
description: List the banks that the payment service supports for card linking.

name: payment.cards
description: List your explicitly linked cards, masked numbers, balances and source IDs. No card is linked automatically.

name: payment.card_payments
description: Inspect your card-funded payment receipts. Supply an operation UUID to check an uncertain payment before retrying; needs_review requires reconciliation.

name: payment.card_payment
description: Pay a world-directory recipient with one explicitly linked card source. Use a canonical UUID and reuse the same ID and body for retries. Amounts are USD cents. Only status completed confirms success; pending, bank_debited and needs_review must not be treated as completed.

name: payment.receipt
description: Read one real wallet ledger transfer visible to your account. A committed transfer with the expected payee, amount and order reference can verify a purchase. Card-funded credits use the same transfer UUID as the card-payment request.

name: payment.history
description: Read your recent wallet ledger transfers, including incoming payments. Use actual ledger receipts to verify money received.
